title: Resolved: complete-picks phone navigation and fixture discovery
detail: The canonical complete-picks page made phone readers cross eight quick links and then repeat fixtures before reaching evidence, with 13.6px probabilities, 40px filter targets and no persistent navigation or combined search. The page now has compact quick links, team/tournament search, method filters with result counts/reset, direct evidence and limitation links, a labelled evidence section, 16px phone probabilities, 44px targets and fixed mobile navigation. At 320/390px the first row begins 401/320px earlier than baseline; neither width overflows, and the 390px axe audit has zero violations. Evidence: data/research/be27c3f6/mobile-baseline.json and mobile-after.json; tests/test_be27c3f6_mobile_complete_picks.py; tests/browser/be27c3f6_complete_picks.spec.mjs.

title: Resolved: stale overview check marks now retire with their evidence cards
detail: The published evidence cards correctly retired current-pick language when a snapshot aged or a lock passed, but the overview's static check mark could remain. Server rendering and the existing spawn-pick-safety-updated event now keep each overview marker in the same state as its card: current rows show a check mark, while retired rows say Snapshot and retain the sourced estimate for audit. No probability, deadline or pick is recalculated by this presentation guard. Static and browser regressions cover both directions without reviving a server-retired recommendation.

title: Deployed picks are missing 9 fixtures present in the official live lobby
detail: At the 2026-10-24T05:44:04Z read, the official CS2 lobby and official scheduled-fixture API agreed on 25 current fixture IDs. The deployed 2026-10-23T20:09:44Z snapshot had 19 active rows: 16 overlap, three have since left the live lobby, and these nine current fixtures are absent: 1079658 Acend-FORZE Reload; 1081152 HAVU-Azuolas; 1079659 Spirit Academy-Lavked; 1081153 Saint Sinners-6yuBoJlbl; 1079660 INOX Division-BRUTE; 1081154 BakS-ILLYRIANS; 1079661 Nuclear TigeRES-ex-Zero Tenacity; 1081156 Spirit Academy-LFO 10; 1081158 FORZE Reload-ex-RUSTEC. Every official start matched for the 16 overlapping IDs. No probability is inferred here and Hotspawn popularity was ignored. Exact UTC times, links and limitations: data/research/be27c3f6/live-inventory-audit.json. Refresh/origination owners must resolve these through the normal evidence ladder; this presentation audit does not overwrite their data.
